newsitem.title: USA: Morton's to open first overseas restaurant.
newsitem.headline: Morton's to open first overseas restaurant.

text.p: Morton's Restaurant Group Inc said Thursday its Morton's of Chicago steakhouses are going global with the opening of its first overseas restaurant, in Singapore.

Allen Bernstein, chairman and chief executive officer, said the company has signed a lease to open a Morton's of Chicago in the five-star Oriental Hotel, located in Singapore's business and financial district.
Bernstein said several other international opportunities for Morton's of Chicago are being reviewed, and the acceleration of the company's domestic development program is under active consideration.
